=== init-depend ===
--- samba
depend() {
	need net
	after firewall
}
--- dbus
depend() {
	need localmount
	after bootmisc
}
--- avahi-daemon
depend() {
	before netmount nfsmount
	use net
	need dbus hostname
}
--- wsdd
depend() {
	need net
	need samba
}
--- crond
depend() {
	need localmount
	need logger
}
--- sshd
depend() {
	use logger dns
	after entropy

	if [ "${rc_need+set}" = "set" ] ; then
		: # Do nothing, the user has explicitly set rc_need
	else
		# shellcheck disable=SC2155
		local x addrs="$(print_listen_addresses)"
		if [ -n "$addrs" ] ; then
			need net
			ewarn "You are binding an interface in ListenAddress statement in your sshd_config!"
			ewarn "You must add rc_need=\"net.FOO\" to your /etc/conf.d/sshd"
			ewarn "where FOO is the interface(s) providing the following address(es):"
			for x in $addrs; do
				ewarn "  ${x%:*}"
			done
		fi
	fi
}
--- syslog
depend() {
	need clock hostname localmount
	provide logger
}
--- /etc/conf.d/wsdd
# /etc/conf.d/wsdd

# Override the default user/group under which wsdd runs.
# Must follow the user[:group] notation.
#WSDD_USER="wsdd:wsdd"

# Specify alternative log file location.
#WSDD_LOG_FILE="/var/log/wsdd.log"

# Disable automatic detection of the workgroup from samba configuration.
#WSDD_WORKGROUP="MYGROUP"

# Additional options for the daemon, e.g. to listen on interface eth0 only.
# Refer to wsdd(1) for details.
#WSDD_OPTS="-i eth0"
--- /etc/rc.conf (lines that are no comments)
rc_tty_number=12
respawn_delay=2
respawn_max=5
respawn_period=1800
